name: request-status-chip
title: Request Status Chip
description: Where a request stands, as one chip: the tone follows the lifecycle state, the words are the state's, the table's renamed label or a stage name.

meta.whenToUse: A request's status in a row, a header or a card.
meta.whenNotToUse: A task's workflow status (StatusIcon), or any other record's tag (Badge).
